projects.title: Download Manager
projects.summary: A free Windows desktop download manager with a browser companion and a public installer.
projects.role: Personal software project: development, testing, Windows packaging, and release website.
features: Built a download queue, progress tracking, and history with parallel connections for compatible servers.
Added a Chrome and Edge companion extension for sending links to the desktop app.
Packaged a Windows installer with tray operation, startup settings, and four interface themes.
projects.challenge: Coordinating download state across the desktop application and browser integration, and packaging the required runtime for installation on another PC.
projects.result: Published a free Windows installer and a website with previews and installation instructions.
projects.imageAlt: Download Manager desktop application in its dark theme

projects.title: Centipede Arcade Game
features: Recreated the classic Centipede arcade game using structured programming in C++.
Utilized SFML (Simple and Fast Multimedia Library) for sprite rendering, audio, and window management.
Built core game mechanics: player fire controls, centipede segmentation, and mushroom grids.
Structured logic with functions, arrays, and pointer manipulation to ensure smooth execution.
projects.summary: A C++ and SFML recreation of the Centipede arcade game, built around structured programming.
projects.challenge: Coordinating movement, projectile collisions, and game state in a grid-based arcade loop.
projects.result: Implemented a playable arcade project with scoring, lives, and SFML graphics and audio.

projects.title: Network Design & Simulation
features: Designed and simulated a multi-layer enterprise network topology in Cisco Packet Tracer.
Configured dynamic routing protocols including OSPF, EIGRP, and RIP for packet routing.
Applied VLSM subnetting, DHCP services, NAT routing, and Access Control Lists (ACLs).
Validated end-to-end connectivity, traffic flow, and security rules across all subnets.
projects.summary: A simulated enterprise network with routing, addressing, and access-control configuration.
projects.imageAlt: Cisco Packet Tracer network topology from the university networking project

projects.title: Game Boy — C++ & SFML
features: Defined C++ classes for snake segments, points, and game structure.
Used SFML for a graphical window, sprites, keyboard input, and timed movement.
Practiced separating state and rendering behavior into C++ classes.
projects.summary: An object-oriented university game project exploring SFML graphics, keyboard input, and Snake game components.

projects.title: Events & Venue Booking System
features: Developed a desktop interface in Java and JavaFX.
Used SQL Server to persist booking and venue records.
Documented the design with use cases, class diagrams, and sequence diagrams.
projects.summary: A JavaFX desktop application for managing events, venues, and booking records.

projects.title: Zuma Deluxe Clone
features: Developed game logic in x86 Assembly.
Worked with keyboard input, movement, and game-state updates.
Implemented color-matching and collision behavior.
projects.summary: A university game project exploring x86 Assembly through a Zuma-inspired implementation.

projects.title: OS-Based Game Engine
features: Applied process and thread concepts to game tasks.
Used synchronization primitives, including mutexes and semaphores, to coordinate shared resources.
Explored concurrent execution and resource management.
projects.summary: A C++ university project exploring operating-system concepts through a game framework.

projects.title: Hospital Database System
features: Designed ER/EER models and relational schemas.
Applied normalization principles to reduce redundant data.
Built PHP forms and reporting queries against SQL Server.
Used XAMPP for local development and testing.
projects.summary: A hospital records database project using SQL Server, database modeling, and PHP forms.
